title: Risk list at /risk-center/risks loads and displays previously seeded risks after a deploy
preconditions: Deploy of risk-management-service and/or vibrantix-client-panel just completed
Project with at least one pre-existing risk
steps: Log in and select the known project
expectedResult: The pre-existing risk(s) still appear in the list with their names, risk level badges, and phase intact — confirms GET /organizations/:orgId/risks and the DB connection survived the deploy.

title: Risk detail page loads and shows correct score/level for a known risk after a deploy
preconditions: A known risk with a recorded inherent score/level
steps: Compare the displayed inherent score/level against the previously known value
expectedResult: GET /risks/:riskId returns 200 with the same score/level as before the deploy — confirms calculateRiskLevel()/scoring logic wasn't broken by the release.

title: Treatment Plan section on the risk detail page loads without error after a deploy
description: risk-register/[id]/page.jsx renders a 'Treatment Plan' Section reading risk.treatment (falling back to risk.riskTreatment for older documents) — a quick confidence check that this fallback and the treatment sub-view didn't regress.
preconditions: A known risk with an existing treatment plan (strategy, status, milestones)
steps: Open the known risk's detail page
Scroll to (or click) the 'Treatment Plan' section
expectedResult: Treatment strategy, status, and milestone list render with their previously known values — no blank section, spinner stuck, or console error.

title: Risk-center dashboard widgets render with non-error state after a deploy
preconditions: Project has at least one risk
steps: Confirm the heat map and top risks widgets render
expectedResult: Heat map cells and the top risks list populate from current data (not an error state or all-zero placeholder), confirming the dashboard aggregation endpoints survived the deploy.

title: Creating a risk via the API succeeds and the new risk is immediately visible in the list
steps: POST /organizations/:orgId/risks with a minimal valid payload (name, category, riskType, projectId, likelihood, impact)
expectedResult: POST returns 201 with a generated riskId (RISK-YYYY-NNNN); the follow-up GET includes the new risk without requiring a cache-clear or delay — confirms the write path and cache invalidation both survived the deploy.
